title: Terms Schedule — The Retrofit Reduction by Project Value, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Retrofit Reduction by Project Value

Schedule fixing the reduction a closed project at the building accounts for when the performance baseline of a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions is restated. The major project amount is USD 1000000 and the middle project amount is USD 400000; the major reduction is 22 percent, the middle reduction 15 percent and the standard reduction 8 percent.

## Schedule

Where a closed project at the building carries a contract value reaching the major project amount, the retrofit reduction is the major reduction. Where a closed project at the building carries a contract value reaching the middle project amount but short of the major project amount, the retrofit reduction is the middle reduction. In every other case the retrofit reduction is the standard reduction.

## Table

| Contract value of the closed project at the building | Retrofit reduction |
|---|---|
| USD 1000000 or more | 22 percent |
| USD 400000 or more but under USD 1000000 | 15 percent |
| under USD 400000, or no closed project at the building | 8 percent |

The contract value is read from the company's records of the project at that building under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects, on a project standing closed.

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

A closed project of USD 1000000 exactly carries the major reduction of 22 percent; one of USD 999999 carries the middle reduction of 15 percent. A closed project of USD 400000 exactly carries 15 percent; one of USD 399999 carries the standard 8 percent.
